groupDescriptions.setup: Install Omahedron and change system options in your flake (omarchy.*); each verb rebuilds. You never open a .nix file.
groupDescriptions.default: Session defaults. Terminal changes apply immediately and persist omarchy.terminal in your flake.
groupDescriptions.channel: Omahedron release pin: move the omahedron flake input to a tag, then rebuild.
groupDescriptions.pin: Pin or show the Omahedron flake input (same as channel on NixOS).
groupDescriptions.pkg: Declarative packages: omarchy pkg add|drop|install|remove write omarchy-packages.json and rebuild — not pacman; pkg aur * are stubs.
groupDescriptions.update: Flake update + rebuild. Prints pin/channel state (omarchy update pins) before asking to proceed.
groupDescriptions.version: Version and channel information from the shipped Omahedron pin.

shared.applyNote: Writes the consumer flake on the G0 locator and runs nixos-rebuild switch. Agents may edit the same options by hand.

errors.noConsumerFlake: No consumer flake found. Set OMARCHY_NIX_FLAKE or install under /etc/nixos with a matching nixosConfigurations entry.
errors.rebuildFailed: nixos-rebuild switch failed. Your flake was not changed, or was rolled back. Check the log and try again.
errors.invalidProfile: Profile must be desktop or workstation.
errors.invalidUnfree: Use: omarchy setup unfree on | off
errors.invalidFingerprint: Use: omarchy setup fingerprint on | off
errors.invalidTerminal: Terminal must be foot, ghostty, alacritty, or kitty.
errors.ianaTimezone: Timezone must be a valid IANA name (e.g. America/Chicago). Not city nicknames like USA/Dallas.
errors.unfreePkgAddDesktop: That package needs unfree software. On the desktop profile, run: omarchy setup unfree on — then try omarchy pkg add again.
errors.pacmanStub: NixOS: packages are declarative. Use omarchy pkg add or omarchy pkg drop (or the Install / Remove menus), not pacman or AUR.
errors.aurStub: There is no AUR on NixOS. Use omarchy pkg add with a catalog ID or nixpkgs attribute, or edit omarchy-packages.json in your flake.

setup.name.summary: Set your full name in the flake (git and shell identity)
setup.name.description: Updates omarchy.full_name in the consumer configuration and rebuilds. Seeds git and the shell on next login.

setup.email.summary: Set your email in the flake (git identity)
setup.email.description: Updates omarchy.email_address in the consumer configuration and rebuilds.

setup.timezone.description: Updates omarchy.timezone and rebuilds. Use IANA names such as Europe/London or America/Chicago.

setup.profile.description: desktop is the thin Omarchy session (default). workstation adds Docker, zram, and creative/dev extras. Rebuilds after the change.

choices.workstation: Adds Docker, zram, LibreOffice, Kdenlive, mise, and related extras

setup.unfree.summary: Allow unfree packages on the desktop profile
setup.unfree.description: Turns omarchy.unfree.enable on or off and rebuilds. Required before omarchy pkg add can install Obsidian and other unfree catalog entries on desktop.

onSuccess.on: Unfree packages are enabled. You can install Obsidian and other unfree menu entries with omarchy pkg add.
onSuccess.off: Unfree packages are disabled. omarchy pkg add will refuse unfree catalog entries until you run omarchy setup unfree on.

setup.fingerprint.summary: Enable or disable fingerprint unlock for the lock screen
setup.fingerprint.description: Sets omarchy.fingerprint.enable and rebuilds. When enabled, enroll each finger once with fprintd-enroll after the rebuild completes.

onSuccess.on: Fingerprint unlock is enabled. Run fprintd-enroll as your user to register a finger.
onSuccess.off: Fingerprint unlock is disabled. The lock screen uses your password only.

setup.autologin.summary: Skip SDDM and land on the desktop (or turn autologin off)
setup.autologin.description: Sets omarchy.autologin.user and rebuilds. Useful on LUKS installs where you already typed the disk password at boot. Use off to require the login screen again.

onSuccess.user: SDDM will log in as that user automatically after reboot.
onSuccess.off: SDDM will show the login screen again.

default.terminal.summary: Set the default terminal (live switch and persisted in the flake)
default.terminal.description: Changes the session default terminal immediately and writes omarchy.terminal in the consumer flake, then rebuilds so the choice survives the next generation. Choices: foot, ghostty, alacritty, kitty.

pin.summary: Pin or show the Omahedron flake input tag
pin.description: With no argument, prints the current omahedron input pin. With a tag (e.g. omahedron-4.0.2), updates the consumer flake.lock input and rebuilds. Not a pacman channel.

channel.set.summary: Pin the omahedron flake input to a release tag
channel.set.description: Same as omarchy pin <tag>: moves the omahedron flake input in your consumer flake and rebuilds. Arch channel names do not apply on NixOS.

pkg.add.summary: Add packages to omarchy-packages.json and rebuild (not pacman)
pkg.add.description: Routes at omarchy-nix-add. Accepts catalog IDs (install.browser.firefox), the Arch package names the Install menus use, or raw nixpkgs attributes (firefox, ripgrep). Writes omarchy-packages.json in your consumer flake and rebuilds. Never pacman. Unfree catalog entries on desktop need omarchy setup unfree on first.

onSuccess.default: Installed. Undo the system with omarchy rollback or the boot menu; files under $HOME are unchanged.

pkg.drop.summary: Remove packages from omarchy-packages.json and rebuild (not pacman)
pkg.drop.description: Routes at omarchy-nix-remove. Removes catalog IDs, menu Arch names, or nixpkgs attributes from omarchy-packages.json and rebuilds.

onSuccess.default: Removed from the declarative package list and rebuilt.

pkg.install.summary: Search nixpkgs interactively and add picks (not pacman)
pkg.install.description: Routes at omarchy-nix-search: fzf over a cached nixpkgs index, then one locked omarchy-nix-add transaction and rebuild. Same declarative omarchy-packages.json path as omarchy pkg add.

pkg.remove.summary: Remove installed packages (interactive when no names given)
pkg.remove.description: Routes at omarchy-nix-remove. With names, removes them in one transaction and rebuilds. With no arguments, opens an interactive multi-select over omarchy-packages.json.

rollback.summary: Switch to the previous NixOS generation (not Snapper; $HOME unchanged)
rollback.description: Runs nixos-rebuild switch --rollback on your consumer flake — the previous system generation only. Not Snapper, not pacman undo. Does not roll back files under $HOME (~/.config, themes, Hyprland overrides stay as they are). Use --list to print generations; pick an older one from the systemd-boot menu at boot (the brick path).
rollback.homeWarning: Rollback does not roll back $HOME. Your edited config files stay as they are across generations.

update.pins.summary: Print Omahedron pin, omarchy-src tag, newest stable, and channel state
update.pins.description: Machine-readable lines: pin (flake.lock omahedron ref/rev or unlocked), omarchy-src (shipped pin manifest), newest-stable (GitHub latest tag or unknown (offline)), channel (shipped pin with security-fast-path yes|no). omarchy update prints this block before it asks to proceed.

version.channel.summary: Print the release channel and state from the shipped pin
version.channel.description: Shows the Omachron channel (stable, rc, edge) and state from schema/pin.json shipped with Omahedron — not an Arch pacman channel.

update.summary: Flake update and rebuild; prints pins before asking to proceed
update.description: Prints omarchy update pins (Omahedron pin, omarchy-src tag, newest stable Omarchy, channel state), asks to proceed, then runs nix flake update on your consumer flake and nixos-rebuild switch. Not pacman -Syu. If the update misbehaves, omarchy rollback returns the previous generation; $HOME is unchanged.

printContract.footer: Rollback is a boot generation, not Snapper. Files under $HOME are not rolled back.
